# Gone Fishing: what's new

## v1.6
- **Fish that belong where they're caught.** Each place now has the fish that really live there. Pine Lake has
  Pumpkinseed, Brown Bullhead and Kokanee. Willow River has Redside Shiner, Westslope Cutthroat and the new Mountain
  Whitefish. Driftwood Bay has Pacific Mackerel, Yelloweye Rockfish, Starry Flounder, Albacore Tuna and the new Lingcod
  and Redtail Surfperch, and the Admiral is now a giant Pacific halibut that only takes a jig on the bottom. Your
  catches carry over to the new species.
- **Livelier fights.** Now and then a hooked fish turns and runs at the boat, or dives under it to the other side.
  Reel fast to keep the line tight, or it can throw the hook. Each species fights in its own way.
- **Wildlife on the shore.** Deer, elk, moose, bears, wolves, foxes and herons, each where they really live. They
  graze, drink and look up, pass behind the trees, and bolt if you come too close. Eagles and ospreys dive for fish,
  and sea lions swim in Driftwood Bay. And something very rare lives deep in the Columbia...
- **Redrawn scenery and skies.** Trees cast shadows and catch the sun, no two alike. The sky has real cloud types
  that change with the weather and the time of day: cumulus, towering storm clouds, cirrus, mackerel skies and low
  grey layers.
- **New: Settings → Graphics → High detail** (all off to start, for devices with power to spare). Extra-smooth
  motion, wind in the trees, and the boat's shadow and lantern light underwater.
- **The lantern** now glows softly and lights the water around the boat.
- **Keyboard support.** Under **Settings → Controls**, **Button prompts** shows controller buttons or keyboard keys,
  and **Keyboard keys** lets you choose your own keys. Escape and the arrow keys always work.
- **Hold a direction** in menus and on the name screen to move through them quickly.
- **Petting** looks natural now: the angler leans over and pats with the free hand.
- Old saves keep working.

## v1.5.1
- **Fixed: a crash when the boat turned** while your angler wore certain tops. The hoodie (on some builds), the
  fleece and the overalls could stop the game with "Could not open file gfx/char/...". Every Look choice has since
  been checked in every pose and turn angle.
- **Idle fishing is smarter:**
  - It no longer turns the boat and casts at the same moment. It finishes turning and lets the boat settle first,
    so the line always goes out the right side.
  - It casts toward fish that like the lure you have on, and only turns round when the other side is clearly better.
  - It fishes each lure its own way: bait is left still, spinners and spoons get slow pulls, the Diving Crank a
    steady retrieve so it dives, poppers short chugs, and jigs a twitch now and then.
  - It lets the lure down to where the fish are, reels in and tries again when nothing's interested, and moves
    somewhere better after a few casts with nothing.
- Old saves keep working; nothing in your save changes.

## v1.5
- **A new tackle box.** It slides up, the latch flips and the lid opens. Its pages are **Cooler**, **Gear**,
  **Achievements**, **Log**, **Map**, **Look** and **Settings**; **L / R** move between them.
  - **Gear** is now the shop too: pick **Rods, Lines, Lures, Floats, Coolers, Boats** or **Motors** and that tray
    rises out of the box, every item in its own labelled compartment. Buy or equip right there.
  - On the **Cooler** page the box turns into the cooler you own.
  - Long names and descriptions never run off the page any more: a line that doesn't fit slides sideways to show
    the rest, and a long description scrolls.
- **Achievements:** 65 of them (up from 22), in **Catch, Species, Skill, Gear, Life** and **Secret** (hidden until
  you earn them). Claiming one pays coins and puts its award (a medal, trophy, rosette, plaque or certificate) in the
  box. Some give you a **title** to wear with your name (11 to earn), and five unlock new colours on the Look page.
  A small pop-up tells you when you've earned one. Your daily requests are on the same page.
- **Settings, reorganised** into **Save and exit** (now at the top), **Sound**, **Gameplay**, **Graphics**, **HUD**
  and **Controls**:
  - **Sound:** a separate level for **Menu clicks**.
  - **Gameplay:** **Idle fishing**, and **Auto-keep catches** (catches go straight into the cooler).
  - **Graphics > Performance:** **Low effects (all off)** for slower devices, or turn each effect off on its own
    (**Smooth motion**, **Sky detail**, **Detailed reflections**, **Light under the water**, **Full splashes**).
  - **Graphics > Scenery life:** **Wild animals**, **Birds and fireflies**, **Swaying water plants**,
    **Kiteboarders and windsurfers** and **Bridge traffic**, each **On** or **Off**.
  - **Graphics > Time of day:** **Day and night**, **Always dawn**, **Always day**, **Always dusk** or **Always night**.
  - **HUD:** **Coins and cooler**, **Button hints**, **Achievement pop-ups**, **Messages**, **Cast power meter** and
    **Line tension meter**, each **On** or **Off**.
  - **Controls:** **Swap A and B** and **Swap X and Y** are now two separate settings, each **On** or **Off**, for
    handhelds that print either pair the other way round (before, one **Button layout** setting swapped both).
    **X: Reset** puts every button back.
  - **Save now** says how often the game saves on its own: every 30 seconds, and after each catch, sale and purchase.
- **Runs well on more devices.** The first time you fish on a device, the game checks how fast it runs. If it's
  slow, it turns on **Low effects (all off)** and tells you, with where to change it. A short tip at the start says where the
  graphics settings are (tick **Don't show this again** to hide it).
- **Fills any screen.** On screens that aren't 4:3 the game shows more of the water instead of black bars.
- **Smoother motion:** scenery and fish glide in fine steps on big screens instead of jumping whole pixels.
- **Fish, animals and your dog or cat turn round in 3D** instead of flipping. Fish face the lure to bite, hold it in
  their mouth, and don't dither back and forth; small fish swim in schools and swim into view rather than appearing.
- **Water and sky:** new splashes (with recorded splash sounds), rings and foam round everything on the surface,
  better reflections, glints on the waves, light patterns on the bottom, the Milky Way at night.
- **Your angler's Look:** hats, glasses, tops and neckwear are redrawn so each one looks like the real thing and
  nothing looks like anything else. Glasses are now **Round** and **Square** (clear lenses) and **Sunglasses**; the
  **Short Sleeve** top was the same as the **T-Shirt**, so it's gone (a save wearing it shows the T-shirt; aviators show as
  sunglasses).
- **The Columbia River:** the bridge traffic (cars, pickups, semis, box trucks, log trucks, campers) and the
  kiteboarders and windsurfers are redrawn, to scale.
- Cats have new meows.
- You can cast as soon as you stop rowing or let off the motor.
- **Fixed:** the highlight in the tackle box could vanish after switching pages with L / R.
- **Fixed:** names and places overlapping on the save screen.
- Old saves keep working; nothing in your save is lost.

## v1.4.1
- **Fixed: the lure getting stuck after taking the bobber off.** If you removed the bobber in the tackle box while
  your lure was in the water, the lure froze and couldn't be reeled in until you put the bobber back on. Now the
  float comes off the line properly, and the lure sinks and reels in like any other cast. Thanks to the player who
  reported it!
- **Fixed: the version number overlapping the stats** on the Settings page. It now sits at the end of the top row.
- Smaller screenshot for PortMaster.
- Old saves keep working; nothing in your save changes.

## v1.4
- **Fixed: the bobber getting stuck at the boat.** Reeling a bobber in now brings the float steadily to just off the
  bow, and the bait then rises up to it before the rig comes out of the water. It no longer stalls against the hull or
  jumps the line up from the bottom all at once.
- **Lures now do what they say:**
  - **Jigs, the Glow Jig and Stink Bait drop to the bottom** after the cast.
  - Every lure sinks at its own speed when you let line out.
  - **Spinners, spoons, cranks and the trolling plug** need to be reeled or trolled. Fish chase them and hit them
    hard, and they ignore one that just sits there.
  - **Worms and Stink Bait** work best left still; fish nibble first, and a worm being dragged around puts them off.
  - Fish smell **Stink Bait** from all around, more the longer it sits.
  - Fish **rise from deep down** to take the **Popper** or the **Dry Fly**, with a splash. The popper chugs along in
    short pops.
  - The **Diving Crank** really dives now when you reel it; before, it stayed at the surface. It also goes deeper.
  - Every fish still likes the lures it liked before. A worm now tempts most fish a little.
- **Trolling tows your lure.** The Auto Trolling Motor now backs the boat slowly away from your cast, the way anglers
  troll with an electric motor, so the line comes tight. The lure is towed behind the boat, and diving lures swim down
  to their diving depth. Before, the boat drove toward its own lure.
- **Bobber notes.** The tackle box now shows how well each lure works under a bobber. Worms and Stink Bait are great,
  jigs work, and spinners, cranks, poppers, spoons, flies and plugs don't.
- A lure is never yanked up suddenly when the line comes tight, and a topwater lure a fish lets go of bobs back up.
- Fish caught near the boat come in just outside the hull.
- Old saves keep working; nothing in your save changes.

## v1.3
- **Realistic casting.** The rod flings the lure, and air drag and line peeling off the spool slow it in flight.
  Heavy, compact lures (jigs, spoons, plugs) cast farthest; light baits like a worm or a dry fly fall short. Thicker
  line costs a little distance, and better rods add a little.
- **You control the depth.** After the splash the lure sinks only on the slack the cast left, then holds. Hold
  **Down** to feed out line and let it sink deeper; **Up** or **A** winds in, first lifting the lure, then drawing it in.
  The lure no longer keeps sinking on its own.
- **Bobbers.** Buy a **Slip Bobber** in the shop's new **Floats** section and fit or remove it under Gear. The float rides
  the surface with your bait hanging below it. **Up/Down** set the depth, **A** reels the rig in. The float twitches on
  nibbles and gets pulled under on a take.
- **Button layout setting.** If A/B (and X/Y) are labelled the other way round on your device, swap them in
  **Settings → Controls → Button layout**. It applies everywhere, including menus and the save screen, and is saved
  for the device, so it holds across all save slots.
- **Fixed:** casts could occasionally go wrong and send the lure flying off. Every cast now starts from a clean rig, and
  a lure can't leave the water area.
- Old saves keep working: new gear simply starts unequipped.

## v1.2
- **Three save slots.** After pressing A on the title screen, choose a save. Start a new game in an empty slot and
  name your angler with the on-screen keyboard.
- **Delete a save** with X on the save screen. It asks twice before anything is deleted, and the second question starts
  on "No, keep it".
- Your existing save moves into slot 1 automatically. Nothing is lost.
- **Exit to title:** Settings now has one **Save and exit** option, which opens Save now, Exit to title (to switch
  saves) and Quit game. The separate "Save game" and "Save and quit" rows are gone, so Settings is shorter.
- A short **Saving… / Saved!** popup shows whenever you save, exit to title or quit.
- The Settings page shows which save you're playing.
- **Fixed:** blurry, garbled picture on some devices (for example Retroid Pocket 5 with ROCKNIX), where the screen
  briefly reports a different scale while going fullscreen. Thanks to the PortMaster crew for tracking it down.

## v1.1
- **Fixed:** A and B were swapped. A now casts, reels and strikes, and B reels fast and goes back, matching the
  labels printed on your handheld. The button map was corrected, and under PortMaster the game now reads buttons only
  through PortMaster's own controls, as other ports do.
- The version number now shows on the title screen and in Settings.

## v1.0
- First release: five places, 42 fish, five legends, ten lures, boats and trolling motors, weather and seasons,
  goals, a customizable angler, and a dog or cat for company.
